column1: # IPv4 CIDR -> Zela region mapping consumed by build.rs.
# region must be exactly one of: Frankfurt | Dubai | NewYork | Tokyo
# Deterministic continental rule (apply offline at bootstrap, then encode the
# result here — runtime never sees country codes):
#   Middle East + South Asia + East/South Africa .. Dubai
#   East Asia + SE Asia + Oceania ................. Tokyo
#   1. Snapshot `getClusterNodes` over a few epochs; collect gossip IPs.
#   2. Resolve each /16 (or larger) supernet to ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 via
#   3. Apply the rule above (country -> Zela region).
#   4. Append rows here, sorted by start address. build.rs panics on overlap
